title: Webinar this week featuring Dr. Struan Grant
summary: On Thursday, April 13, Dr. Struan Grant will present a seminar on variant-to-gene mapping for common complex traits.
bodyHtml:
Please join us on Thursday, April 13 for our next KPN webinar, featuring guest speaker Struan Grant of the University of Pennsylvania. Dr. Grant is Director of the Center for Spatial and Functional Genomics at the Children's Hospital of Philadelphia, where he leads a group studying the genetics of common diseases with a focus on pediatric disease. He is also a member of the AMP® CMD consortium that is generating genetic and genomic results to accelerate the development of new therapeutics for common diseases. In this webinar, he will present his work to develop a strategy for prioritizing potential effector genes at genetically implicated loci.

Details on joining the webinar are below and are also embedded in this flyer. Please circulate it to interested colleagues! We hope to see you on Thursday, but we’ll also record and post the webinar for those who can’t make it.
